prompt:
Extract every policy commitment stated in the text below.

Rules:
- One commitment per line.
- Write each as a verb phrase: an action followed by its object. For example: "raise the income tax threshold" or "build 300000 new homes".
- State each commitment at the level of a distinct policy action, not its implementation details. Do not subdivide a single commitment into steps.
- Include every commitment. Do not select, rank, prioritise, or judge importance.
- Use the text's own terms for policy objects. Do not substitute synonyms.
- Do not number the lines. No bullets, headings, preamble, or commentary.
- If the text states no policy commitments, output the single word NONE.

<text>
Summary of Green Party Manifesto 2024 (policy proposals only)

Health and social care
- NHS: Reduce waiting lists; rapid GP access; universal NHS dentistry; reverse privatisation. Extra revenue funding in England rising from ~£8bn in year 1 to £28bn by 2030; at least £20bn capital over five years.
- Primary care/public health: +£1.5bn/yr for primary medical care by 2030; £2bn primary care capital; restore public health budgets (+£1.5bn); expand community diagnostics.
- Dentistry: New NHS contract; investment rising to £3bn/yr by 2030; free dental nursing for children/low-income groups via community hubs.
- Workforce: Pay restoration (incl. junior doctors); immediate budget uplift to settle pay disputes.
- Mental health: Access to evidence-based therapies within 28 days; tailored services; trained counsellor in every school and sixth-form college (with bursaries).
- Cancer: National plan to boost early diagnosis and prevention.
- Drug policy: National commission to move toward legally regulated markets.
- Assisted dying: Support legal change with safeguards.
- HIV: End new transmissions by 2030 with expanded opt-out testing and wider PrEP access.
- Social care: Free personal care; national pay/career structure; end overseas worker exploitation; £20bn/yr investment; +£3bn for children’s social care; disability benefits +5%; SEND transport guarantees.

Housing and planning
- Build 150,000 new social homes/yr; end Right to Buy; empower rent controls; end no‑fault evictions; tenancy boards; long-term leases.
- Retrofit: £29bn (homes to EPC B), £4bn (public buildings), £9bn (low‑carbon heating), £7bn (overheating adaptation) over five years; area-based delivery; property‑linked finance.
- Standards: Passivhaus-equivalent for new homes; mandate solar and low‑carbon heating; raise PRS minimum to EPC C; embodied carbon reporting; reuse of demolition materials.
- Planning: Infrastructure-first development; protect Green Belt; distribute small sites; restore public building control; make demolition subject to planning.

Energy and climate
- No new oil/gas licences; end subsidies; carbon tax escalating over a decade; cease new nuclear and phase out existing.
- Targets: ~70% of electricity from wind by 2030; by 2035 aim for 80GW offshore, 53GW onshore, 100GW solar; end onshore wind restrictions; rooftop solar mandate.
- Community energy: Minimum local ownership thresholds; Local Electricity Bill; remove regulatory barriers; Crown Estate to public ownership (Welsh assets devolved).
- Grid/storage: Expand grid, interconnectors, offshore networks; scale storage; green hydrogen for industry; regulate biofuels; end imported biomass subsidies (e.g., Drax).

Economy, work, welfare, tax
- Green investment: Avg ~£40bn/yr over parliament for power, retrofit, rail electrification, public transport, active travel, industry decarbonisation, water/sewage, and nationalisations.
- Public ownership: Rail, water, Big 5 retail energy companies.
- SMEs/community: Regional mutual banks (capitalised incl. £10bn public funds); grants via LAs (£2bn/yr); Prompt Payment Code in law.
- Work: Repeal anti‑union laws; Charter of Workers’ Rights; £15/hr minimum wage (all ages) with support for small firms; 10:1 pay ratio; day‑one rights; gig workers classed as ‘workers’; equal pay audits; move toward four‑day week; safe sick pay.
- Welfare: +£40/week to UC/legacy benefits; end five‑week wait; scrap two‑child cap and bedroom tax; disability benefits +5%; uprate pensions; carer’s allowance +10%; end sanctions; long‑term UBI.
- Tax: Wealth tax (1% >£10m; 2% >£1bn); align CGT and investment income rates with earnings; remove NI upper limit; equalise pension tax relief to basic rate; reform inheritance tax; council tax revaluation; steps toward Land Value Tax; windfall taxes; VAT shifts (cut hospitality/arts; raise on financial services/private education); carbon tax (£120/t rising toward £500/t in 10 years); stronger anti‑avoidance; borrow to invest; cancel Trident replacement.

Nature, animals, food
- Rights of Nature Act; Climate and Nature Act; Clean Air Act; protect 30% land/sea by 2030; rewet peat; expand woodland; DEFRA +£1.5bn; water firms to public ownership; Right to Roam; urban nature measures; ban harmful pesticides incl. glyphosate; strengthen protected sites; marine protections and ban destructive fishing.
- Animals: Commission on Animal Protection; ban blood sports; end factory farming practices (cages, routine antibiotics); end badger cull; license humane culling; ban lead ammo/snaring; tighter breeding/imports; phase out animal testing; regulate greyhound/horse racing.
- Food/farming: Almost triple farm support over five years for agroecology; link payments to pesticide reduction; expand horticulture; reduce meat/dairy; free school meals for all children plus breakfast clubs; food education; local food partnerships/funds; supply-chain fairness; strengthen Groceries Code Adjudicator/FSA; expand productive forestry and wood-waste reuse.

Education
- Schools: +£8bn incl. £2bn teacher pay; £2.5bn/yr for repairs/RAAC; reduce high-stakes testing and abolish Ofsted; Natural History GCSE; return academies/free schools to LA control; end private schools’ charitable status and apply VAT (exempt SEND places); protect breakfast clubs.
- Early years: £1.4bn/yr for Sure Start; extend funded childcare to 35 hours from 9 months (sector-negotiated).
- SEND: +£5bn for inclusive provision; accessibility; transport.
- Health/wellbeing in schools: Restore school nurses; universal school/college counsellors.
- Post‑16/FE/HE: +£3bn sixth form; £12bn FE/skills; restore EMA; scrap tuition fees; restore maintenance grants; address TPS costs.

Transport
- Public transport: Subsidies rising to £10bn/yr; £19bn extra over five years for rail, buses, electrification, active travel; free buses for under‑18s; nationalise rail; LA control of buses; £2.5bn/yr for walking/cycling.
- Roads/EVs: Oppose new roads; restore fuel duty escalator; road pricing; end new petrol/diesel car sales by 2027; end use by 2035; £5bn/yr EV scrappage by end of parliament; default 20mph; weight‑based VED; expand rail freight and HGV transition.
- Aviation: Frequent‑flyer levy; ban domestic flights with <3h rail alternative; tax kerosene via carbon tax; halt airport expansion; transition support for workers.

Democracy, rights, migration
- Fair Politics Act: Repeal Elections Act 2022; proportional representation; restore Electoral Commission powers; state party funding; stronger lobbying/think-tank transparency; votes at 16; online safeguards; replace Lords with elected chamber; constitutional commission; expanded devolution; +£5bn/yr for English local government.
- Rights: Defend HRA/ECHR; restore legal aid; scrap PCSC and Public Order Acts; scrap Prevent; trans self‑ID; end spousal veto; X passport marker.
- Migration/asylum: End hostile environment; safe routes; right to work while awaiting decisions; abolish NRPF and 10‑year route; limit detention; voting rights for visa holders; new Department of Migration; cost‑price fees; free NHS access; remove spousal income thresholds; family reunion.

Culture/media/digital
- +£5bn over five years for local arts, culture, sport; protect venues; VAT exemption for cultural events; local business rate discretion; EU visa‑free touring for musicians.
- Media/digital: 20% market cap per owner; implement Leveson; Digital Bill of Rights; strong data/AI regulation aligned with international standards; protect creators’ IP.

Crime and justice
- Policing: End routine stop‑and‑search and facial recognition; stronger diversity fitness; improved democratic oversight.
- Justice: Presumption against custodial sentences <2 years; expand diversion schemes; invest ~£11bn over parliament to restore MoJ, legal aid, courts; recruit judges.
- VAWG: Make misogyny a hate crime; fund local services; decriminalise sex work.

Foreign policy and defence
- International law focus; support Ukraine; EU re‑entry pathway (Customs Union, free movement, Erasmus); climate finance to 1.5% GNI by 2033; ODA to 1% GNI by 2033; Loss & Damage fund; ecocide law; debt relief; reparations commission.
- Israel/Palestine: Immediate permanent ceasefire; recognise Palestine; end UK arms exports to Israel; pursue war-crimes accountability.
- Defence: Sign TPNW; cancel Trident and dismantle nuclear weapons; NATO reform (no‑first‑use, defence‑only posture, diplomacy-first).
